summary: Senior review of src/engine. The module was already complete and largely sound. I checked the maths, diagnoses, hints, Spanish copy, mastery rules and generation budget against the spec and PEDAGOGY.md, and fixed four real defects plus one wording issue. Fixes: (1) the mirror fact 7×6 used the wrong visual parameters at hint level 3; (2) the "5" trick text read as an equality; (3) check() with a null or malformed answer returned an empty expected string in logs; (4) the brand-new-fact budget (max 3 per call) could be exceeded when a later kind had only hard facts; (5) adult subtraction labels said "llevadas" where "préstamos" is correct. Added regression tests. Typecheck is clean for src/engine and all 189 engine tests pass.
publicApi: Unchanged contract: createRng, generate, check, hintsFor, strategyForFact, newMastery, updateMastery, dueSkills, fluencyThresholdMs, starsFor, factGrid, describeSkill, describeError, planSession, selectorForSkills, plus the types GenerateOptions, AttemptForMastery, SessionPlan. The StrategyDetail interface (internal to strategies.ts) gained an optional workedParams field. No exports were removed.
tests: npx vitest run src/engine: 189 passed (was 185; 4 new). npm run typecheck filtered to src/engine: zero errors. Coverage could not be measured because @vitest/coverage-v8 is not installed and I did not install packages. Engine gallery captured on iPad (shots/engine-review.png) and reviewed: layout and Spanish copy look clean.
openIssues: Coverage is not measured (tool missing). The ~95% line-coverage target is unverified.

Adaptive mix: for a child with very few seen skills (1-2), the new-item share exceeds ~30% by design (target = n - 2*seen). Left as is; the choice protects a brand-new child from repetition-only sessions.

Word problems never include division with a remainder (only exact or long variants are generated). checkWord also accepts a plain number for a remainder word problem without checking the remainder. Low risk because the generator does not produce remainder word problems.
'long' division exercises always have a zero remainder (the pool is remainder 0 only). This is a documented limitation.
feedback copy contains {child} and {pet} placeholders that the activities layer must render with renderTemplate; activities are not built yet, so this is unverified end to end.
wordCorrect says 'Son 1 <unit>' when the answer is 1 (singular grammar); not generated in practice.
notesForOtherModules: Feedback strings in src/engine/feedback.ts contain {child} and {pet} placeholders. The activities and content layers must render them with renderTemplate before display.
hintsFor level-3 params for the 7×6 mirror now use the 6×7 orientation (a:6,b:7) with the dots-five-plus-one visual. The visual renderer should expect that convention.
